★ WHAT'S ON THE TRUCK

Four doors.
Every protein covered.

Each panel on the truck is its own cold room. Here's what's behind every latch.

Door 01

Beef

Ribeyes, tomahawks, tri-tip and heavy-cut grinds, marbled the way a butcher keeps them for himself.

Door 02

Poultry

Whole birds, breasts and wings — restaurant-grade, every time you scan the cooler.

Door 03

Seafood

Door 04

Pork

Chops, ribs and roasts, cut thick and stacked for whoever gets to the truck first.

THE ONE EVERYONE ASKS FOR

The Tomahawk

Bone-in and hand-trimmed, marbled edge to edge — this is the cut regulars come back for first. Every order is vacuum-sealed and kept frozen until it hits your grill.

We buy from small beef, seafood and poultry suppliers we've vetted ourselves — not a warehouse pallet. If it's on the truck, someone on our crew has already cooked it at home.

★ THE MAN BEHIND THE TRUCK

Alonzo Pratt III

Founder & CEO

Alonzo is Chicagoland born and raised, with a lifelong obsession for good meat done right. Eighteen years ago he started selling premium cuts out of a single small freezer — no truck, no crew, just a guy who wouldn't sell anything he wasn't feeding his own family.

That freezer grew into a fleet. Today Chicago Prime Cuts is one of the fastest-growing meat distributors in Chicago and Northwest Indiana — and Alonzo still hand-picks the suppliers and still shows up to the lot himself most weekends.
